analysis: Examined ProviderLoop+Serve.swift head 1-604 and the ProviderLoop+Testing.swift patch (head 141-151) plus base text. The only production change is Serve.swift:108: when usesHostServices, run() arms verifiedWeightHashesFile = VerifiedWeightHashStore.path(), a persisted record of verified managed-load weight hashes, set before the startup preload gate (126) and before registration carries loopConfig.modelHashes/liveModelHashes (185, 218). Testing.swift adds internal seams setVerifiedWeightHashesFileForTesting and setLoadWeightHasherForTesting (replaces the full-weight read behind load-time hash capture). These are internal (reachable only in-module or via @testable) and not DEBUG-gated, but no production caller is visible; not a regression on the evidence supplied. Security relevance: T-012/T-027/A-004 (operator weight substitution) and T-041 mitigation that SSD cache binding uses a verified weightHash in coordinator mode (cacheEligibleWeightHash). The persisted store lives on operator-writable disk (TB-003). If load-time logic trusts a persisted entry (e.g. keyed by path/size/mtime) to skip a fresh full-weight hash, an operator could swap weights while preserving metadata and inherit a stale verified hash, both for advertised weightHash and SSD cache-binding. VerifiedWeightHashStore, captureWeightHash, loadWeightHasher consumers and ensureModelLoaded are not supplied, so this contract is unverified and no finding is raised. Integration must check: whether stored entries can satisfy requireFreshCryptographicHash or cache eligibility without a full re-read; file permissions/no-follow handling of the store path; whether stored hashes are reported to the coordinator as verified; and that the hasher override cannot be set outside tests. Rest of run() (App Attest resume responder bound to fixed key 205-213, connection-control split 400-429, authorization clearing 416/425/436) appears unchanged per range map.
